pages.quiz:
COMPUTER STUDIES MARCH — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #3
====

GRADE: Grade 12
SUBJECT: COMPUTER STUDIES MARCH
TIME ALLOWED: 45 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 30
EXAM BODY: KNEC / KCSE pathway

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. A computer’s main brain for processing is the: (1 mark)
   A. Speaker
   B. Monitor
   C. CPU
   D. Keyboard

2. Before using a sharp tool in a workshop, you should: (1 mark)
   A. Work alone with eyes closed
   B. Run with the tool
   C. Wear safety gear and follow instructions
   D. Remove all guards

3. When learning Career Opportunities, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Skip safety briefings for Career Opportunities.
   B. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Career Opportunities.
   C. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Career Opportunities.
   D. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Career Opportunities.

4. When learning Robotics, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Skip safety briefings for Robotics.
   B. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Robotics.
   C. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Robotics.
   D. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Robotics.

5. When learning Cloud Computing, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Cloud Computing.
   B. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Cloud Computing.
   C. Skip safety briefings for Cloud Computing.
   D. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Cloud Computing.

6. When learning Emerging Technologies, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Emerging Technologies.
   B. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Emerging Technologies.
   C. Skip safety briefings for Emerging Technologies.
   D. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Emerging Technologies.

7. When learning Artificial Intelligence Concepts, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Skip safety briefings for Artificial Intelligence Concepts.
   B. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Artificial Intelligence Concepts.
   C. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Artificial Intelligence Concepts.
   D. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Artificial Intelligence Concepts.

8. When learning Network Troubleshooting, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Network Troubleshooting.
   B. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Network Troubleshooting.
   C. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Network Troubleshooting.
   D. Skip safety briefings for Network Troubleshooting.

9. ICT stands for: (1 mark)
   A. Input Cable Tester
   B. International Cricket Team
   C. Internal Cooking Timer
   D. Information and Communication Technology

10. When learning Data Structures, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Data Structures.
   B. Skip safety briefings for Data Structures.
   C. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Data Structures.
   D. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Data Structures.

11. Electricity safety rule: (1 mark)
   A. Insert metal objects into sockets for fun
   B. Ignore burnt cables
   C. Never touch live wires with wet hands
   D. Overload every socket

12. When learning Cybersecurity, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Cybersecurity.
   B. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Cybersecurity.
   C. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Cybersecurity.
   D. Skip safety briefings for Cybersecurity.

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
13. In three clear sentences, explain Software Project Management and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

14. In three clear sentences, explain Emerging Technologies and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

15. In three clear sentences, explain Artificial Intelligence Concepts and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

16. In three clear sentences, explain Artificial Intelligence Implications and Ethics and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)
